name: Multi-core BONO Tree Traversal and Ray Casting with Dynamic Tile Grouping
definition: A multi-core parallel rendering method that divides screen space into contiguous regions for Phase I (BONO tree traversal to build block lists) and partitions ray casting tasks into Z-ordered tiles grouped by weight for Phase II (dynamic load-balanced ray casting).
summary: A multi-core volume rendering method that uses weight-based Z-order tile grouping to achieve tight load balancing and minimize synchronization overhead during dynamic ray casting.
